name: Dao
desc: Conform to the Heavenly Dao, breathe in spiritual energy (Qi), and improve cultivation realm through practice.

name: Buddhism
desc: Save all sentient beings, and improve cultivation realm through meditation and sudden enlightenment.

name: Confucianism
desc: Educate the common people, cultivate the Noble Spirit (Haoran Qi), and the realm will increase accordingly.

name: Nature
desc: Take Heaven and Earth as teacher, follow the Way of Nature.

name: Martial
desc: Entering the Dao through martial arts and Body Tempering. Although progress is slow, the foundation is solid, and breaking through bottlenecks comes as naturally as eating and drinking.
